interface.displayName: Codex 用量悬浮窗 / Quota Widget
interface.shortDescription: Plus 用量窗 / Plus quota widget
interface.longDescription:
面向 ChatGPT Plus 用户深度定制的 Windows x64 置顶悬浮工具，需 .NET 8 Desktop Runtime 和已登录的 Codex。显示 5h/周剩余额度、恢复时间及今日/累计 token；支持拖动复原、三种语言、自定义语言包与可选开机启动。

A Windows x64 Codex usage widget deeply tailored to ChatGPT Plus users. Requires .NET 8 Desktop Runtime and an active Codex login. Shows remaining 5-hour/weekly quotas, reset times, and daily/lifetime tokens. Supports dragging, position reset, three languages, custom language packs, and optional startup at sign-in. Independent project, unaffiliated with OpenAI.
